behavior: new conversations have no fabricated override
single-agent and graph runs resolve the saved conversation model
stale run admission is rejected before run/history creation
clearing the selection returns to the active provider-profile default
forked sessions preserve their selected model state
CLI /model and browser/VS Code selectors expose the selection

validation.browser_command: node --test --test-name-pattern=browser saves a selected model to the active conversation views/browser/tests/controller.test.cjs

parity_assessment: The durable per-conversation capability is implemented and exercised through native HTTP, CLI, browser and VS Code client contracts. This is not marked operation-level parity: xMind has a different local route and request shape, requires provider/session revision bindings, returns a state receipt instead of 204, and adds a provider-default reset. Synthetic provider peers were used; no live model request or installed VS Code UI selection was part of this acceptance.
